description: Compute a funnel report whose steps are defined in a configuration table rather than hard-coded. funnel_steps lists the ordered steps. A user counts at step N only if they have at least one event for step N AND counted at every earlier step (membership funnel; timestamps are not compared). Every configured step must appear even when no user reached it. Output columns: step_order (INT64), step_name (STRING), users (INT64), pct_of_previous (FLOAT64, 4 decimals; NULL for step 1 and when the previous step has 0 users), pct_of_first (FLOAT64, 4 decimals). Sort by step_order.

step_name.description: Event name that marks the step

event_name.description: Event name; may include names that are not funnel steps

edge_cases: User 5 has trial_start without visit/signup and must not count at step 3
Step 'paid' has no events but must be reported with 0 users
Events whose name is not a configured step are ignored
Adding a fifth step to funnel_steps must work without changing the query
common_failure_modes: FM3: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) per event name counts users who skipped earlier steps (trial_start = 2)
FM1: INNER JOIN from steps to events drops steps with no events
FM7: Division without SAFE_DIVIDE fails when a previous step has zero users
